records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of David. To bring to remembrance.

en.L: For the director: of David; to bring to remembrance.
en.B: For the music director. Of David. For remembrance.
en.R: For the leader of the music. By David. To call to mind.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : de David ; pour faire souvenir.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. Pour faire mémoire.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. De David. Pour rappeler à Dieu.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: ya Daudi; kwa kukumbusha.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Kwa ukumbusho.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ya Daudi. Kwa kumkumbusha Mungu.

es.L: Al director del coro: de David; para hacer recordar.
es.B: Al director del coro. De David. Para recordar.
es.R: Para el director de la música. De David. Para traer a la memoria.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: của Đa-vít; để nhắc nhớ.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Của Đa-vít. Để tưởng nhớ.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Của Đa-vít. Để nhắc lại trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 다윗의 [시]. 기억나게 하기 위하여.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 다윗의 시. 기념하기 위하여.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. 다윗이 지은 노래. 하나님께서 기억해 주시기를 구하며.

pt.L: Para o regente: de Davi; para trazer à lembrança.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. De Davi. Para lembrança.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. De Davi. Para fazer lembrar.

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: दाऊद का; स्मरण दिलाने के लिए।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। दाऊद का। स्मरण के लिए।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। याद दिलाने के लिए।

ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. Написал Давид. Чтобы напомнить.

uk.B: Для диригента хору. Давидів. На згадку.
uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. Давидова пісня. Щоб пригадати.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: to bring to remembrance: to call to mind before God
decisions.reason: As in 38:1, the only other psalm with this heading. The psalm may call the sufferer's need to God's mind, or may have been sung with the "memorial portion" of the grain offering ('azkarah, Leviticus 2:2), a word from the same root.

decisions.choice: Psalm 70 is Psalm 40:14-18
decisions.reason: Verses 2-6 repeat Psalm 40:14-18 with small changes: several times "God" stands where Psalm 40 has the divine name, and the other way round in verse 6. Psalms 42-83 often use "God" ('elohim) where other psalms use the name, and each level here follows the word this psalm has.

decisions.choice: By David; To call to mind
alternatives: Of David; To bring to remembrance
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words, as in 38:1; the sense of the phrase is uncertain (m3).

decisions.choice: "Pour rappeler à Dieu" at Readable
decisions.reason: French "rappeler" needs to say to whom; the title asks that the psalmist's need be brought to God's mind (meaning decision m3), so Readable names God.

decisions.choice: "Kwa kumkumbusha Mungu" (to remind God) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Swahili verb needs an object, and the meaning decision reads the heading as calling the sufferer's need to mind before God; Readable names God as the one reminded.

decisions.choice: "Để nhắc lại trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời" (to call to mind before God)
decisions.reason: The title asks God to remember the one who prays (see the meaning decision); "nhắc nhớ" alone would leave a new reader asking who is to remember what, so Readable says it.

decisions.choice: "하나님께서 기억해 주시기를 구하며" at Readable
decisions.reason: The title asks that the singer be called to mind before God (meaning decision); Readable says so plainly, where Literal and Balanced keep the bare phrase.

decisions.choice: para trazer à lembrança (L); Para lembrança (B); Para fazer lembrar (R)
decisions.reason: The heading of Psalm 38:1 (m3), in the words its Portuguese set for both psalms.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: to bring to remembrance as "ለማሳሰብ" (L), "ለመታሰቢያ" (B), "ለማስታወስ" (R), as Psalm 38:1
decisions.reason: The same heading word, so the same wording.

decisions.choice: verses 2-6 copy the Hindi of Psalm 40:14-18 at each level, changing only what the Hebrew changes
decisions.reason: Psalm 70 repeats Psalm 40:14-18 with small changes (meaning m4). As the poetry note sets for parallels, each level keeps the wording of Psalm 40 in this translation and differs only where the Hebrew differs ("God" for the name and the other way round, "turn back" for "be appalled", "hurry to me" for "think of me", some words left out), with a decision at each change. The lines follow the English level here, which sets Psalm 70 in lines. The title's "स्मरण दिलाने के लिए" phrases follow Psalm 38:1.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; "तू" to God
alternatives: a capitalised pronoun, as the English "You"
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). This holds for the whole psalm.

decisions.choice: "для воспоминания" (L); "Для памяти" (B); "Чтобы напомнить" (R)
decisions.reason: The sense of the term is uncertain (to call something to mind before God, or a memorial offering); each level follows the English level and keeps the wording open.

records.literal_gloss: God, to deliver me; YHWH, to my help hurry.

en.L: God, [come] to rescue me; \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hurry to my help!
en.B: God, come and rescue me! \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be quick to help me!
en.R: God, come and save me! \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hurry and help me!

fr.L: Ô Dieu, [viens] me délivrer ; \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, hâte-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de me secourir !
fr.B: Ô Dieu, viens me délivrer ! \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, viens vite à mon secours !
fr.R: Dieu, viens me sauver ! \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dépêche-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de m’aider !

sw.L: Ee Mungu, [uje] kuniokoa; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ufanye haraka kunisaidia!
sw.B: Ee Mungu, uje uniokoe! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uharakishe kunisaidia!
sw.R: Mungu, njoo uniokoe! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, fanya haraka unisaidie!

es.L: Oh Dios, [ven] a librarme; \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡apresúrate a socorrerme!
es.B: ¡Oh Dios, ven a rescatarme! \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡date prisa en ayudarme!
es.R: ¡Dios, ven y sálvame! \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡ven pronto a ayudarme!

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, [xin đến] giải cứu tôi; \q lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mau mau giúp đỡ tôi!
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin đến giải cứu tôi! \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mau đến giúp tôi!
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin đến cứu tôi! \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mau giúp tôi!

ko.L: 하나님, 저를 건지러 [오십시오]. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 서둘러 저를 도와주십시오!
ko.B: 하나님, 오셔서 저를 건져 주십시오! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 어서 저를 도와주십시오!
ko.R: 하나님, 오셔서 저를 구해 주십시오! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 서둘러 저를 도와주십시오!

pt.L: Deus, [vem] me livrar; \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, apressa-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} em meu socorro!
pt.B: Deus, vem me livrar! \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, vem depressa me ajudar!
pt.R: Deus, vem me salvar! \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, vem depressa me ajudar!

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ታድነኝ ዘንድ [ና]፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለእርዳታዬ ፍጠን!
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ናና አድነኝ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፍጠንና እርዳኝ!
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ናና አድነኝ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፈጥነህ ናና እርዳኝ!

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, मुझे छुड़ाने [आ]; \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरी सहायता के लिए फुर्ती कर!
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, आकर मुझे छुड़ा! \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जल्दी कर और मेरी सहायता कर!
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, आकर मुझे बचा! \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जल्दी आ और मेरी सहायता कर!

ru.L: Боже, [приди] избавить меня; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, поспеши на помощь мне!
ru.B: Боже, приди и спаси меня! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, поспеши и помоги мне!
ru.R: Боже, спаси меня! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, скорее приди и помоги мне!

uk.L: Боже, [поспіши], щоб визволити мене; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, поспіши мені на допомогу!
uk.B: Боже, прийди й урятуй мене! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, швидше допоможи мені!
uk.R: Боже, прийди й спаси мене! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, поспіши й допоможи мені!

decisions.choice: God, to deliver me: a cry with the verb left out
alternatives: God, be pleased to deliver me (Psalm 40:14)
decisions.reason: The first line has no main verb, only "to deliver me". Psalm 40:14 begins "Be pleased, YHWH, to deliver me"; here the urgent cry is shorter, and "hurry" at the end of the verse governs both halves.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:14
decisions.reason: This verse matches Psalm 40:14, with "God" in place of the first "YHWH".

decisions.choice: come
decisions.reason: The cry lacks a verb; "come" is supplied from the sense and from "hurry" in the second half. Literal marks it with brackets.

decisions.choice: apressa-te em meu socorro (L); vem depressa me ajudar (B, R)
decisions.reason: Verses 2-6 repeat Psalm 40:14-18 (m2), so each level keeps the Portuguese of that passage wherever the Hebrew is the same, and changes only what Psalm 70 changes: "Deus" where it has God in place of the name (verses 2, 5, 6), the shorter cry without "Tem prazer" (here), "recuem" for "fiquem pasmados" (verse 4), and "apressa-te para mim" for "pense em mim" (verse 6).

decisions.choice: verses 2-6 in the Amharic of Psalm 40:14-18 where the Hebrew is the same; where it differs, the Amharic follows Psalm 70
decisions.reason: Psalm 70 repeats Psalm 40:14-18 (meaning decision m4 on verse 1). The differences followed here: no "be pleased" (verse 2); no "together" or "to snatch it away" (3); "turn back" for "be appalled", and no "to me" (4); "God" for the divine name in "Great is God" (5); "God, hurry to me" for "may the Lord think of me", and the divine name for "my God" (6). Elohim is "እግዚአብሔር" with no span; only YHWH has the divine_name span.

decisions.choice: "हे परमेश्वर, मुझे छुड़ाने [आ]" (L), "आकर मुझे छुड़ा" (B), "आकर मुझे बचा" (R)
alternatives: "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे छुड़ाने की कृपा कर", as Psalm 40:14
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:14 has "Be pleased, LORD"; here the cry is "God" with no main verb (meanings m1, m2), so the first line differs from Psalm 40 and supplies "come", as the English does. The second line keeps Psalm 40:14's Hindi at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 40:14-18 at each level
decisions.reason: Psalm 70:2-6 repeats Psalm 40:14-18 (m2), so each level copies the Russian of Psalm 40 where the Hebrew is the same. Here the Hebrew differs: it has "God" ("Боже") where Psalm 40:14 has the divine name, and no "be pleased" ("Благоволи", "пожелай"), so the first line is shorter.

source.text: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: May they be ashamed and abashed, those who seek my life; may they be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.

en.L: May they be ashamed and abashed, those who seek my life; \q may they be turned back and humiliated, \q those who desire my harm.
en.B: Let those who are out to take my life be shamed and confounded; \q let those who want me hurt be driven back in disgrace.
en.R: Some people want me dead. Let them be ashamed and confused. \q Some people want to see me hurt. \q Make them turn away in shame.

fr.L: Qu’ils soient honteux et confus, ceux qui cherchent ma vie ; \q qu’ils reculent et soient humiliés, \q ceux qui désirent mon malheur.
fr.B: Que ceux qui en veulent à ma vie soient couverts de honte et de confusion ; \q que ceux qui souhaitent mon malheur reculent, déshonorés.
fr.R: Certains veulent ma mort. Qu’ils aient honte et soient confus. \q Certains veulent me voir souffrir. \q Fais-les reculer, pleins de honte.

sw.L: Waaibike na kufadhaika wale wanaoutafuta uhai wangu; \q warudishwe nyuma na kufedheheka, \q wale wapendao madhara yangu.
sw.B: Wale wanaotaka kuniua na waaibishwe na kuchanganyikiwa; \q wale wanaotaka niumie na warudishwe nyuma kwa fedheha.
sw.R: Watu fulani wanataka nife. Na waone aibu na kuchanganyikiwa. \q Watu fulani wanataka kuniona nikiumia. \q Uwafanye warudi nyuma kwa aibu.

es.L: Que sean avergonzados y confundidos los que buscan mi vida; \q que retrocedan y sean humillados \q los que desean mi mal.
es.B: Que queden en vergüenza y confusión los que quieren quitarme la vida; \q que los que desean mi daño retrocedan avergonzados.
es.R: Hay quienes me quieren muerto. Que queden avergonzados y confundidos. \q Hay quienes quieren verme sufrir. \q Haz que se vuelvan atrás llenos de vergüenza.

vi.L: Nguyện chúng bị hổ thẹn và bối rối, những kẻ tìm hại mạng sống tôi; \q nguyện chúng phải lui lại và bị nhục nhã, \q những kẻ muốn điều ác cho tôi.
vi.B: Nguyện những kẻ đang tìm lấy mạng sống tôi phải xấu hổ và hoang mang; \q nguyện những kẻ muốn tôi bị hại phải tháo lui trong nhục nhã.
vi.R: Có những kẻ muốn giết tôi. Nguyện chúng phải xấu hổ và bối rối. \q Có những kẻ muốn thấy tôi bị hại. \q Xin khiến chúng phải quay lui trong xấu hổ.

ko.L: 제 목숨을 찾는 자들이 부끄러움과 낭패를 당하게 하시고, \q 물러나서 수치를 당하게 하십시오, \q 제가 해를 입기를 바라는 자들이.
ko.B: 제 목숨을 노리는 자들이 부끄러움과 당혹을 당하게 하시고, \q 제가 해를 입기를 바라는 자들이 창피를 당하며 쫓겨 가게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 저를 죽이려는 사람들이 있습니다. 그들이 부끄러워하고 당황하게 해 주십시오. \q 제가 다치기를 바라는 사람들이 있습니다. \q 그들이 창피를 당하고 물러가게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Sejam envergonhados e confundidos os que buscam a minha vida; \q recuem e sejam humilhados \q os que desejam o meu mal.
pt.B: Que os que caçam a minha vida sejam envergonhados e confundidos; \q que os que me desejam o mal recuem humilhados.
pt.R: Há pessoas tentando me matar. Faz com que elas fiquem envergonhadas e confusas. \q Há pessoas que querem me fazer mal. \q Faz com que elas voltem atrás envergonhadas.

am.L: ነፍሴን የሚሹ ያፍሩ፤ ይደናገሩም፤ \q ወደ ኋላ ይመለሱ፤ ይዋረዱም፤ \q ጉዳቴን የሚወዱ።
am.B: ሕይወቴን የሚፈልጉ ያፍሩ፤ ግራም ይጋቡ፤ \q ክፉ የሚመኙልኝ ወደ ኋላ ተመልሰው ይዋረዱ።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሊገድሉኝ ይፈልጋሉ። አሳፍራቸው፤ ግራም አጋባቸው። \q አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሊጎዱኝ ይፈልጋሉ። \q በኀፍረት ወደ ኋላ መልሳቸው።

hi.L: जो मेरे प्राण के खोजी हैं, वे लज्जित और व्याकुल हों; \q वे पीछे हटाए जाएँ और अपमानित हों, \q जो मेरी हानि चाहते हैं।
hi.B: जो मेरे प्राण के पीछे पड़े हैं, वे लज्जित और घबराए हुए हों; \q जो मेरा बुरा चाहते हैं, वे पीछे भगा दिए जाएँ और अपमानित हों।
hi.R: कुछ लोग मुझे मार डालने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं। उन्हें लज्जित और घबराया हुआ कर दे। \q कुछ लोग मुझे हानि पहुँचाना चाहते हैं। \q उन्हें लज्जित करके पीछे लौटा दे।

ru.L: Да будут постыжены и посрамлены ищущие жизни моей; \q да будут обращены назад и опозорены \q желающие мне зла.
ru.B: Пусть те, кто охотится за моей жизнью, будут постыжены и смущены; \q пусть те, кто желает мне зла, отступят в позоре.
ru.R: Некоторые люди пытаются меня убить. Сделай так, чтобы им было стыдно и чтобы они пришли в смятение. \q Некоторые люди хотят причинить мне зло. \q Заставь их со стыдом повернуть назад.

uk.L: Нехай будуть осоромлені й збентежені ті, хто шукає мого життя; \q нехай повернуть назад і будуть принижені \q ті, хто бажає мені лиха.
uk.B: Нехай ті, хто хоче забрати моє життя, будуть осоромлені й збентежені; \q нехай ті, хто бажає мені зла, відступлять із ганьбою.
uk.R: Деякі люди хочуть моєї смерті. Нехай вони будуть осоромлені й розгублені. \q Деякі люди хочуть бачити, як мені боляче. \q Нехай вони повернуть назад із соромом.

decisions.choice: may they be ashamed: a prayer against enemies
decisions.reason: The verbs are wishes: that the enemies' plans fail and the shame they meant for him falls on them (35:4, 26; 40:15).

decisions.choice: seek my life: try to kill me
decisions.reason: As in 40:15, which adds "to snatch it away" and "together"; this verse is shorter.

decisions.choice: Let them ... Make them ...
decisions.reason: Readable puts the wishes as plain requests, with the enemies named first.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:15's Hindi without "छीन लेने के लिए" and "सब के सब"
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:15 adds "to snatch it away" and "together" (meaning m2); this verse is shorter, so the Hindi leaves those words out and otherwise keeps Psalm 40's wording, set in the English level's lines.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 40:15 without "все вместе" and "чтобы отнять её"
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:15 adds "together" and "to snatch it away" (m2); this verse has neither, so the Russian of Psalm 40:15 is copied without them ("все вместе" (L), "все до одного" (B), "всем" (R), "чтобы отнять её").

records.literal_gloss: May they turn back on account of their shame, those who say, Aha, aha!

en.L: May they turn back on account of their shame, \q those who say, "Aha! Aha!"
en.B: Let those who crow "Aha! Aha!" \q retreat because of their own disgrace.
en.R: Some people laugh and say, "Ha! Ha!" \q Let them run away because they are put to shame.

fr.L: Qu’ils reculent à cause de leur honte, \q ceux qui disent : « Ah ! ah ! »
fr.B: Que ceux qui ricanent : « Ah ! ah ! » \q battent en retraite à cause de leur propre honte.
fr.R: Certains rient et disent : « Ha ! ha ! » \q Qu’ils s’enfuient, couverts de honte.

sw.L: Warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao, \q wale wasemao, "Aha! Aha!"
sw.B: Wale wanaoshangilia, "Aha! Aha!" \q na warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya fedheha yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Watu fulani hucheka na kusema, "Ha! Ha!" \q Na wakimbie kwa sababu wameaibishwa.

es.L: Que se vuelvan atrás a causa de su vergüenza \q los que dicen: «¡Ajá! ¡Ajá!».
es.B: Que los que gritan «¡Ajá! ¡Ajá!» \q retrocedan por su propia deshonra.
es.R: Hay quienes se ríen y dicen: «¡Ja! ¡Ja!». \q Que huyan, porque han quedado en vergüenza.

vi.L: Nguyện chúng phải quay lui vì cớ sự hổ thẹn của chúng, \q những kẻ nói: "A ha! A ha!"
vi.B: Nguyện những kẻ reo lên: "A ha! A ha!" \q phải rút lui vì chính sự nhục nhã của mình.
vi.R: Có những kẻ cười và nói: "Ha! Ha!" \q Nguyện chúng phải bỏ chạy vì bị xấu hổ.

ko.L: 자기들의 수치 때문에 물러가게 하십시오, \q "아하! 아하!" 하고 말하는 자들이.
ko.B: "아하! 아하!" 하며 우쭐대는 자들이 \q 자기들의 수치 때문에 물러가게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: "하하! 하하!" 하고 비웃는 사람들이 있습니다. \q 그들이 창피를 당해 달아나게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Recuem por causa da sua vergonha \q os que dizem: "Ah! Ah!"
pt.B: Que os que zombam dizendo "Ah! Ah!" \q recuem por causa da própria vergonha.
pt.R: Há pessoas que riem de mim e dizem: "Rá! Rá!" \q Que elas fujam envergonhadas.

am.L: ከኀፍረታቸው የተነሣ ወደ ኋላ ይመለሱ፤ \q «እሰይ! እሰይ!» የሚሉ።
am.B: «እሰይ! እሰይ!» እያሉ የሚያላግጡ \q በገዛ ኀፍረታቸው ወደ ኋላ ይመለሱ።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ይስቃሉ፤ «እሰይ! እሰይ!» ይላሉ። \q በኀፍረት ስለ ተዋረዱ ሸሽተው ይሂዱ።

hi.L: वे अपनी लज्जा के कारण पीछे हट जाएँ, \q जो कहते हैं, "अहा! अहा!"
hi.B: जो ताना कसते हैं, "अहा! अहा!", \q वे अपनी ही लज्जा के कारण पीछे हट जाएँ।
hi.R: कुछ लोग हँसते हैं और कहते हैं, "हा! हा!" \q लज्जित होकर वे भाग जाएँ।

ru.L: Да обратятся вспять от стыда своего \q говорящие: «Ага! Ага!»
ru.B: Пусть те, кто насмехается: «Ага! Ага!», \q отступят из-за собственного стыда.
ru.R: Некоторые люди смеются и говорят: «Ха! Ха!» \q Пусть они убегут, когда их постигнет стыд.

uk.L: Нехай повернуть назад через свій сором \q ті, хто каже: «Ага! Ага!»
uk.B: Нехай ті, хто кричить «Ага! Ага!», \q відступлять через власну ганьбу.
uk.R: Деякі люди сміються й кажуть: «Ха! Ха!» \q Нехай вони втечуть, бо їх осоромлено.

decisions.choice: Aha, aha: a gloating laugh
decisions.reason: The cry is the glee of enemies at someone's fall (35:21, 25; 40:16).

decisions.choice: turn back: retreat, as an army turns and runs
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:16 has "be appalled" (shamem); this verse has "turn back" (shuv), repeating the picture of defeat from verse 3.

decisions.choice: on account of their shame: as the result of it
decisions.reason: The word ('eqev) means "as the consequence of": their own shame drives them off.

decisions.choice: "पीछे हट जाएँ" (L, B), "भाग जाएँ" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:16 has "be appalled"; this verse has "turn back" (meaning m2), and no "to me", so the verb differs from Psalm 40's Hindi and "मुझसे", "मुझ पर" fall away. The cry "अहा! अहा!" (L, B), "हा! हा!" (R) is kept.

decisions.choice: "обратятся вспять" (L), "отступят" (B), "убегут" (R) where Psalm 40:16 has "ужаснутся", "поражены", "потрясены"; no "мне"
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:16 has "be appalled" (shamem) and "say to me"; this verse has "turn back" (shuv, m2) and "say", so those words differ from Psalm 40:16, and the rest ("от стыда своего", «Ага! Ага!», «Ха! Ха!») is copied.

source.text: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ׀בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: May they exult and rejoice in you, all who seek you; and may they say continually, Great [is] God, those who love your salvation.

en.L: May they exult and rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, all who seek {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q and may they say continually, "Great [is] God!" \q those who love {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: But may all who look for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be glad and take delight in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and let all who love {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saving help keep saying, "God is great!"
en.R: But let all who come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be happy and full of joy because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Let all who love it when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save them say again and again, "God is great!"

fr.L: Qu’ils exultent et se réjouissent en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent ; \q et qu’ils disent continuellement : « Grand [est] Dieu ! », \q ceux qui aiment {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: Mais que tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent soient dans la joie et trouvent en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} leur bonheur, \q et que ceux qui aiment {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} secours ne cessent de dire : « Dieu est grand ! »
fr.R: Mais que tous ceux qui viennent à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} soient heureux et pleins de joie grâce à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Que tous ceux qui aiment être sauvés par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} disent sans arrêt : « Dieu est grand ! »

sw.L: Washangilie na kufurahi ndani {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} wote wakutafutao; \q na waseme daima, "Mungu [ni] mkuu!" \q wale waupendao wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Lakini wote wanaokutafuta na wafurahi na kukushangilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q na wote waupendao msaada {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuokoa waseme daima, "Mungu ni mkuu!"
sw.R: Lakini wote wanaokuja kwako na wawe na furaha tele kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Wote wanaopenda {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unapowaokoa waseme tena na tena, "Mungu ni mkuu!"

es.L: Que se regocijen y se alegren en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan; \q y que digan continuamente: «¡Grande [es] Dios!», \q los que aman {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.B: Pero que todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan se alegren y se gocen en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q y que todos los que aman {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ayuda salvadora digan siempre: «¡Dios es grande!».
es.R: Pero que todos los que vienen a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} estén felices y llenos de alegría por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Que todos los que se alegran cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los salvas digan una y otra vez: «¡Dios es grande!».

vi.L: Nguyện mọi người tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều hớn hở và vui mừng trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q và nguyện họ luôn luôn nói: "Đức Chúa Trời [là] vĩ đại!" \q những người yêu mến sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nhưng nguyện tất cả những ai tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều hân hoan và vui thỏa trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và nguyện những ai yêu mến ơn giải cứu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn nói: "Đức Chúa Trời thật vĩ đại!"
vi.R: Nhưng xin cho mọi người đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều vui vẻ và tràn đầy niềm vui vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin cho những ai yêu thích được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu cứ nói đi nói lại: "Đức Chúa Trời thật vĩ đại!"

ko.L: 주님을 찾는 모든 이가 주님 안에서 즐거워하고 기뻐하게 하시고, \q 늘 말하게 하십시오, "하나님은 위대하시다!" 하고, \q 주님의 구원을 사랑하는 이들이.
ko.B: 그러나 주님을 찾는 모든 사람은 주님 때문에 기뻐하고 즐거워하게 하시고, \q 주님의 구원을 사랑하는 모든 사람은 "하나님은 위대하시다!" 하고 늘 말하게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 주님께 나아오는 사람은 모두 주님 때문에 기쁘고 즐겁게 해 주십시오. \q 주님께서 구해 주시는 것을 사랑하는 사람은 모두 "하나님은 위대하시다!" 하고 거듭거듭 말하게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Exultem e se alegrem em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscam; \q e digam continuamente: "Grande é Deus!" \q os que amam a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} salvação.
pt.B: Mas que todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} procuram gritem de alegria e encontrem alegria em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q e que os que amam ver-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} salvar nunca deixem de dizer: "Como Deus é grande!"
pt.R: Mas que todos os que vêm a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} fiquem felizes e alegres por causa de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Que todos os que gostam de ver que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} os salvas digam sempre: "Deus é grande!"

am.L: የሚፈልጉህ ሁሉ በአንተ ሐሤት ያድርጉ፤ ደስም ይበላቸው፤ \q ዘወትርም «እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ [ነው]!» ይበሉ፣ \q ማዳንህን የሚወዱ።
am.B: የሚፈልጉህ ሁሉ ግን ደስ ይበላቸው፤ በአንተም ሐሤት ያድርጉ፤ \q የማዳን እርዳታህን የሚወዱ ሁሉ፦ «እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው!» ማለትን አያቋርጡ።
am.R: ወደ አንተ የሚመጡ ሁሉ ግን ስለ አንተ ደስ ይበላቸው፤ ሐሤትም ያድርጉ። \q ስታድናቸው ደስ የሚላቸው ሁሉ ዘወትር፦ «እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው!» ይበሉ።

hi.L: जितने तुझे खोजते हैं, वे सब तुझमें मगन और आनंदित हों; \q और वे निरंतर कहते रहें, "परमेश्वर महान [हैं]!" \q जो तेरे उद्धार से प्रेम रखते हैं।
hi.B: पर जितने तुझे खोजते हैं, वे सब आनंद से जयजयकार करें और तुझमें आनंद पाएँ; \q और जो तेरे उद्धार को देखना चाहते हैं, वे यह कहना कभी न छोड़ें, "परमेश्वर कितने महान हैं!"
hi.R: पर जो लोग तेरे पास आते हैं, वे सब तेरे कारण ख़ुश और आनंदित हों। \q जो लोग तेरे उद्धार से प्रेम करते हैं, वे सदा कहें, "परमेश्वर महान हैं!"

ru.L: Да ликуют и радуются о {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} все ищущие {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}; \q и да говорят непрестанно: «Велик Бог!» — \q любящие {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} спасение.
ru.B: Но пусть все, кто ищет {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, ликуют и находят радость в {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, \q и пусть те, кто любит видеть, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спасаешь, не перестают говорить: «Как велик Бог!»
ru.R: Но пусть все, кто приходит к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, будут счастливы и рады благодаря {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. \q Пусть все, кто любит, когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} их спасаешь, всегда говорят: «Бог велик!»

uk.L: Нехай веселяться й радіють у {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} всі, хто шукає {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; \q і нехай кажуть завжди: «Великий Бог!» — \q ті, хто любить {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} спасіння.
uk.B: Але нехай усі, хто шукає {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, радіють і тішаться {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}, \q і нехай усі, хто любить {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} спасенну допомогу, повсякчас кажуть: «Бог великий!»
uk.R: Але нехай усі, хто приходить до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, будуть щасливі й сповнені радості через {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. \q Нехай усі, хто любить, коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} їх спасаєш, знову й знову кажуть: «Бог великий!»

decisions.choice: Great is God: praise, or a wish
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as a wish, "may God be great", that is, be shown and praised as great. Psalm 40:17 has the divine name here.

decisions.choice: those who seek you: those who turn to God in worship and prayer
decisions.reason: To seek God is to come to him for help and to worship him (9:11; 24:6).

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: The wish for those who seek God is set against the wish for the enemies.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर महान हैं" (L, R), "परमेश्वर कितने महान हैं" (B)
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:17 has the divine name in the saying; here it is "God" (meaning m1), so the Hindi says "परमेश्वर" and otherwise keeps Psalm 40's words at each level, Balanced included (आनंद से जयजयकार करें, तेरे उद्धार को देखना चाहते हैं, कितने महान हैं), though the English Balanced words the two verses differently. Literal keeps the Hebrew order, the speakers after their words, since the English sets them on their own line.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 40:17 with "Бог"
decisions.reason: The verse is Psalm 40:17 with "God" where Psalm 40 has the divine name (m1), so each level copies Psalm 40:17 and says "Бог" for "ГОСПОДЬ".

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י׀עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה־לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I [am] afflicted and needy; God, hurry to me; my help and my deliverer [are] you; YHWH, do not delay.

en.L: But I [am] poor and needy; God, hurry to me! \q My help and my deliverer [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not delay!
en.B: As for me, I am poor and in need; God, come to me quickly! \q You are my helper and the one who sets me free; \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not hold back!
en.R: I am poor and I have nothing. God, come to me quickly! \q You are the one who helps me and saves me. \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please do not wait!

fr.L: Mais moi, [je suis] humilié et indigent ; ô Dieu, hâte-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} vers moi ! \q Mon secours et mon libérateur, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne tarde pas !
fr.B: Quant à moi, je suis pauvre et dans le besoin ; ô Dieu, viens vite vers moi ! \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui m’aides et qui me libères ; \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fais pas attendre !
fr.R: Je suis pauvre et je n’ai rien. Dieu, viens vite vers moi ! \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui m’aides et me sauves. \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, n’attends pas !

sw.L: Lakini mimi [ni] maskini na mhitaji; Ee Mungu, unijie upesi! \q Msaada wangu na mwokozi wangu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikawie!
sw.B: Lakini mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Ee Mungu, uje kwangu haraka! \q Wewe ndiwe msaidizi wangu na mkombozi wangu; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usichelewe!
sw.R: Mimi ni maskini na sina kitu. Mungu, njoo kwangu upesi! \q Wewe ndiye unayenisaidia na kuniokoa. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali usikawie!

es.L: Pero yo [soy] pobre y necesitado; ¡oh Dios, apresúrate a venir a mí! \q Mi ayuda y mi libertador [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}; \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tardes!
es.B: En cuanto a mí, soy pobre y necesitado; ¡oh Dios, ven pronto a mí! \q Tú eres mi ayuda y el que me pone en libertad; \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} detengas!
es.R: Soy pobre y no tengo nada. ¡Dios, ven pronto a mí! \q Tú eres el que me ayuda y me salva. \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡por favor, no esperes más!

vi.L: Nhưng tôi [là người] khốn khổ và thiếu thốn; lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin mau đến cùng tôi! \q Sự giúp đỡ của tôi và Đấng giải cứu tôi [là] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng chậm trễ!
vi.B: Còn tôi, tôi nghèo khó và thiếu thốn; lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin mau đến với tôi! \q Ngài là Đấng giúp đỡ tôi và là Đấng giải thoát tôi; \q lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng trì hoãn!
vi.R: Tôi nghèo khổ và chẳng có gì cả. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin mau đến với tôi! \q Ngài là Đấng giúp đỡ tôi và cứu tôi. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng chờ đợi nữa!

ko.L: 그러나 저는 가난하고 궁핍합니다. 하나님, 제게로 서둘러 [오십시오]! \q 저의 도움이시며 저를 건지시는 분은 주님[이십니다]. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 지체하지 마십시오!
ko.B: 저는 가난하고 궁핍합니다. 하나님, 어서 제게로 오십시오! \q 주님은 저를 도우시는 분, 저를 건져 주시는 분이십니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 머뭇거리지 마십시오!
ko.R: 저는 가난하고 가진 것이 없습니다. 하나님, 어서 제게로 와 주십시오! \q 주님께서는 저를 도우시고 구해 주시는 분이십니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제발 늦지 마십시오!

pt.L: Mas eu [sou] pobre e necessitado; Deus, apressa-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} para mim! \q O meu socorro e o meu libertador [és] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}; \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não demores!
pt.B: Quanto a mim, sou pobre e necessitado; Deus, vem depressa até mim! \q Tu és quem me socorre e me liberta; \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não tardes!
pt.R: Eu sou pobre e necessitado. Deus, vem depressa até mim! \q Tu me ajudas e me salvas. \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por favor, não demores!

am.L: እኔ ግን ጎስቋላና ምስኪን [ነኝ]፤ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ወደ እኔ ፍጠን! \q ረዳቴና ታዳጊዬ አንተ [ነህ]፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አትዘግይ!
am.B: እኔ ግን ድሃና ምስኪን ነኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ፈጥነህ ወደ እኔ ና! \q የሚረዳኝና ነጻ የሚያወጣኝ አንተ ነህ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አትዘግይ!
am.R: እኔ ድሃና ችግረኛ ነኝ። እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ፈጥነህ ወደ እኔ ና! \q አንተ ትረዳኛለህ፤ ታድነኛለህም። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እባክህ አትዘግይ!

hi.L: पर मैं दीन और दरिद्र [हूँ]; हे परमेश्वर, मेरे पास फुर्ती से आ! \q मेरा सहायक और मेरा छुड़ानेवाला तू [है]; \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, देर न कर!
hi.B: जहाँ तक मेरी बात है, मैं दीन और दरिद्र हूँ; हे परमेश्वर, जल्दी मेरे पास आ! \q तू ही मेरा सहायक और मुझे छुड़ानेवाला है; \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, देर न कर!
hi.R: मैं ग़रीब और ज़रूरतमंद हूँ। हे परमेश्वर, जल्दी मेरे पास आ! \q तू ही मेरी सहायता करता है और मुझे बचाता है। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, कृपया देर न कर!

ru.L: А я беден и нищ; Боже, поспеши ко мне! \q Помощь моя и избавитель мой — {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, не медли!
ru.B: А я беден и в нужде; Боже, скорее приди ко мне! \q Ты — тот, кто помогает мне и освобождает меня; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, не замедли!
ru.R: Я беден и в нужде. Боже, скорее приди ко мне! \q Ты помогаешь мне и спасаешь меня. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, пожалуйста, не медли!

uk.L: А я — бідний і вбогий; Боже, поспіши до мене! \q Моя допомога і мій визволитель — {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, не зволікай!
uk.B: А я бідний і в нужді; Боже, прийди до мене швидко! \q Ти — мій помічник і той, хто звільняє мене; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, не барися!
uk.R: Я бідний, і в мене нічого немає. Боже, прийди до мене швидко! \q Ти — той, хто допомагає мені й рятує мене. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, прошу, не чекай!

decisions.choice: afflicted and needy: helpless and dependent on God
decisions.reason: As in 40:18; the pair describes those who have no help but God.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:18
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:18 has "the Lord will think of me" where this verse has "God, hurry to me", and "my God" where this verse has the divine name. The psalm ends as it began, with "hurry" (verse 2).

decisions.choice: "maskini na mhitaji" for the afflicted and needy pair, the words of the terms note
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words describe someone with no help but God. "Maskini" is the word that comes first to a Swahili reader for the first of the pair here; "mnyonge" (the lowly, the oppressed) serves where the English says "afflicted" alone.

decisions.choice: pobre y necesitado
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pair 'ani and 'evyon names someone poor and helpless who has only God to depend on. Spanish uses "pobre" and "necesitado", the words used for this pair throughout the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "가난한" for the afflicted and "궁핍한" for the needy at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "가난한 사람, 고난받는 사람, 궁핍한 사람"; here the pair names one who is helpless and dependent on God (meaning decision), and "가난하고 궁핍합니다" says that plainly.

decisions.choice: "हे परमेश्वर, मेरे पास फुर्ती से आ"; "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, देर न कर"
alternatives: "प्रभु मेरी सुधि लें" and "हे मेरे परमेश्वर", as Psalm 40:18
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:18 has "the Lord will think of me" and "my God"; here the Hebrew has "God, hurry to me" and the divine name (meaning m2). The Hindi changes those words and keeps the rest of Psalm 40:18 at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 40:18 with "Боже, поспеши ко мне" and "ГОСПОДИ"
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:18 has "may the Lord think of me" and "my God" where this verse has "God, hurry to me" and the divine name (m2); those words differ, and the rest is copied from Psalm 40:18 at each level.
